learning_outcomes.text: Learns the effect of noise in baseband transmission.
Compares and analyzes Source Coding (Predictive Coding) techniques.
Gains knowledge about Information and Coding Theory.
Gains knowledge about Error Control Coding (Channel Coding).

syllabus_topics: Effect of Noise in Baseband Transmission - Introduction
Effect of Noise in Baseband Transmission (SNR calculation)
Predictive Codings (Delta Modulation, Adaptive Delta Modulation, Differential Pulse Code Modulation (DPCM), Adaptive DPCM, Linear Predictive Coding (LPC))
Introduction to Information and Coding Theory (Entropy and Information Rate, Shannon-Fano, Huffman codings)
Topic Review and Free Problem Solving
Error Control Coding (Linear Block Codes, Hamming Distance, Syndrome Decoding)
bibliography: Carlson A.B., Crilly P.B., Rutledge J.C., Communication Systems, McGraw-Hill, 4th Ed., 2002
Proakis J. G., Digital Communications, McGraw Hill, 2001
Haykin S., Communication Systems, John Wiley, 1994
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
